title: My profile
subtitle: Your account details, password, two-factor authentication and preferences.
detailsSub: Shown to other admins in audit logs and assignments.
nameMin: Name must be at least 3 characters
mobileInvalid: Enter a valid Iraqi mobile (+964 7XX XXX XXXX)

password.title: Change password
password.sub: Use at least 10 characters with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol.
password.same: New password must differ from the current one
password.updated: Password updated — other sessions were signed out

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.sub: Protect your account with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password).
mfa.step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code from the app
mfa.invalid: Invalid code. In this demo, use 123456.
mfa.disableBody: Your account will only be protected by a password. Super Admin policy recommends keeping 2FA on.
mfa.activeNote: Sign-ins require a code from your authenticator app.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.languageSub: Also switches layout direction and fonts.
prefs.themeSub: Your choice is remembered on this device.
prefs.emailAlertsSub: Also email me admin alerts (new support tickets, ready exports, reconciliation issues). Security emails are always sent.
